reason: A DSH Web GUI client plugin that adds 16 selectable community color themes and a settings-based theme picker through semantic token overrides.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 16 套可在设置中切换的社区配色主题。
summaries.en: Adds 16 selectable community color themes and a theme picker to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

capabilities: registers 16 selectable color themes for the DSH Web GUI
injects a theme selector into the settings interface
overrides exposed CSS theme tokens in the client UI
